This multi-page report presents the saved results from the data-description,
growth, hormone, and microbiome analyses. Use the navigation menu to move
between the analysis stages.

The report pages read the outputs produced by the analysis scripts. Rendering
this report does not refit the statistical models.

## Report contents

- Description of the analysis datasets
- Stage 1 gender-stratified growth analysis
- Stage 1 growth analysis
- Stage 2 hormone analysis
- Stage 3 microbiome analyses at species, genus, and phylum levels
